In the member sheet's Documents section (`frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/MemberDocuments.tsx`), each document is rendered fully expanded — title, date, description, and the attached file list (`DocumentFileList`) are always visible. With several documents on a member, this section gets long and hard to scan.

## Expected Behavior

Clicking anywhere on a document's row (outside the edit/delete buttons) should toggle a collapsed/expanded state for that document — collapsed shows just the title (and maybe date), expanded shows the full description and file list, similar to how other collapsible sections in the app work (see `RecordSectionCard`, which `MemberDocuments` already renders inside, for the pattern to reuse).

## Suggested approach

- Add per-document collapsed state (e.g. a `Set<string>` of expanded document IDs, or default-collapsed vs default-expanded — worth confirming with design/UX) in `MemberDocuments.tsx`.

- Hide/show the description + `DocumentFileList` block based on the collapsed state.

- [ ] Clicking a document row (not its buttons) toggles showing/hiding its description and file list
- [ ] Edit and delete buttons still work without triggering the collapse toggle
- [ ] Keyboard/a11y: row should be reachable and toggleable via keyboard too (e.g. `role="button"` + `tabIndex`/`onKeyDown`, or a dedicated disclosure control)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `## [Unreleased]`

## Review of PR #804 — `feat(member-sheet): collapse/expand documents on click`

**Overview**: Implements issue #801. `MemberDocuments.tsx` gains a local `Set<string>` of expanded document ids (default: empty → all collapsed). Each document row's title/icon block becomes a native `<button aria-expanded>` that toggles its own id in the set; the description and `DocumentFileList` are gated behind `isExpanded`. Edit/Delete remain sibling `<Button>`s outside the toggle, so no click-propagation workaround is needed. Includes a new `MemberDocuments.test.tsx` (3 tests) and a `CHANGELOG.md` entry.

### Correctness
- No nested-interactive-element anti-pattern: the disclosure `<button>` and the Edit/Delete `<Button>`s are siblings, not nested — genuinely avoids the propagation hack the issue floated, and is more robust than `stopPropagation`.
- State update (`toggleExpanded`) creates a fresh `Set` per call, so React re-renders correctly; no stale-closure risk.
- Content gating (description + `DocumentFileList` hidden when collapsed) matches the acceptance criteria exactly.
- Keyboard accessibility is inherited for free from using a real `<button>` (Enter/Space activation, tab-reachable) — matches the criteria without extra `onKeyDown` code.

### Style / Conventions
- Mirrors `RecordSectionCard`'s existing idiom closely (chevron swap, `aria-expanded`, accessible name = title text, no new `aria-label`) — good consistency, and correctly avoids adding new i18n keys (verified `check-i18n` still passes with zero new keys).
- TypeScript strict, no `any`, no dead code left behind from the refactor.
- CHANGELOG entry is well-placed under `### Changed` and matches the file's existing terse, `(#NNN)`-suffixed style.

### Test Coverage
- Three focused tests: default-collapsed state, click-to-toggle (and back), and edit/delete-buttons-don't-toggle (via `within(row).getAllByRole("button").filter(...)`, which is a nice way to avoid a brittle button-index assumption).
- Minor gap (non-blocking): no test explicitly fires a `keyDown` (Enter/Space) to exercise the keyboard path from the acceptance criteria — relying on native `<button>` semantics is reasonable, but an explicit keyboard test would make that guarantee visible in the suite rather than implicit.

### Risks / Nitpicks (none blocking)
- The clickable/toggle area is the title+icon `<button>` sized via `flex-1`, not the full row `<div>` (which still has its own padding). Clicking in the outer card's padding whitespace (not on the button) won't toggle. This matches the row's visual bounds closely enough to satisfy "click anywhere on the row" in practice, but it's not literally 100% of the row's hit area — not worth a fix.
- Decorative icons (`FileText`, `ChevronDown`/`ChevronRight`) aren't `aria-hidden`, but this matches the pre-existing pattern in `RecordSectionCard`, so it's not a regression introduced by this PR.

### Verdict
Clean, well-scoped implementation that follows established patterns exactly. No correctness, security, or performance issues. Full test suite (674 tests), build, i18n check, `check-no-any`, `check-transport-boundary`, and prettier all pass. Good to merge as-is.
